Know what’s real

Roads and outlines: OpenStreetMap. Ground slopes: elevation data, where available. The 3D ground uses the newest EOX Sentinel-2 cloudless mosaic we can reach (2025, falling back to 2024–2020 or bundled tiles), or a north-up aerial photo you supply (fitted to about 260 m). Building heights use mapped values or estimates. Doors, windows and foundations are generated, not surveyed. Mapped fences and trees are placed when present; a photo stage also guesses terracotta roofs, tree canopies and grassy yards. No Google imagery is collected. GovMap tiles are not downloaded automatically.

Paused.

Take a breath. The sector can wait.

W moves toward your aim; S moves back; A/D strafe relative to your aim. Shift runs; C crouches under low openings; Space jumps larger ledges (small steps are automatic). Click or hold FIRE to shoot. V swaps 2D/3D. In 3D, click to capture the mouse and look freely; drag if capture is unavailable. In 2D, point to aim; mouse wheel or the elevation slider looks up/down. R reloads; Q switches weapon; H toggles aim assist. Touch: left stick moves, right stick looks, hold FIRE to shoot.
